reason: Phenotype spans multiple systems (orofacial clefting, craniofacial dysmorphism, short stature/short neck, limb anomalies, neurodevelopment/ADHD). That breadth supports keeping a moderately deep PCF list to cover heterogeneous syndromic causes driven by HPO. Facial gestalt is informative (ptosis, telecanthus, depressed nasal bridge, long philtrum, cleft-related facial features), but can overlap across many syndromes and image quality/age effects add uncertainty, so retain a smaller yet meaningful GestaltMatcher set. Asymmetric allocation (12/8) balances expected recall from phenotype-driven ranking with incremental value from facial similarity while keeping total review cost within 20.
